description: Decode Solana account data or an Anchor event (a 'Program data:' log line or emit_cpi instruction data) using a bundled IDL snapshot of 40 programs. Matches the 8-byte discriminator (or exact size for SPL Token and other programs without one) and returns field values plus the matched account or event page. No RPC; pass the bytes you already have. Programs can upgrade, so a layout can lag the deployed program. Free, no payment needed. Use when you have raw account data or an event log and need its fields.

data.description: Account data (base64 as returned by getAccountInfo, hex, or base58), a full 'Program data: <base64>' log line, or event instruction data.

program_id.description: Optional program ID or slug (e.g. raydium-amm-v4). Needed for programs whose accounts have no discriminator.

name: decode_solana_account
title: Solana account / Anchor event decoder (free)
